reasoning_traces.think:
The surplus value primitive computes a normalized difference between a fitted APY curve and rookie cost, enabling valuation of draft picks beyond initial contract data. It relies on isotonic regression to ensure monotonicity of APY trends. The trait scoring primitive applies TF-IDF with bias adjustments to extract scout-relevant features from textual scouting reports. These features are deconfounded using position-specific means and school-based offsets. Volatility classification assesses stability through absolute error deviation from expected volatility. Each primitive operates under distinct assumptions: isotonicity for APY, fixed term weights for TF-IDF, and quantile thresholds for volatility. Failure modes include unstable fits when |volOe| ≥ 0.05, misalignment of trait weights due to insufficient data, and incorrect volatility categorization from skewed distributions.
